tasks.IdentifyRightMostItemColor: Determine the color of the right-most item on the nightstand based on the given arrangement.

answer: The exact order of the items on the nightstand is: 1. A silver dog leash, 2. A mauve bracelet, 3. A pink textbook, 4. A fuchsia pencil. The right-most item is the fuchsia pencil, so its color is (H) fuchsia.
